# [17.0.0](https://github.com/react-native-google-signin/google-signin/compare/v16.2.0...v17.0.0) (2026-10-29)

### Features

* **ios:** opt-in Swift Package Manager resolution for GoogleSignIn ([#1529](https://github.com/react-native-google-signin/google-signin/issues/1529)) ([1b44e23](https://github.com/react-native-google-signin/google-signin/commit/1b44e23a94c90675d5a734a6a8a99d4eb26a2419))

⭐ **Tip**: there's a [paid version of the package](https://universal-sign-in.com/#pricing) with a [new implementation](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/one-tap), advanced [security features](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/security), support for [web](https://react-native-google-signin.github.io/docs/setting-up/web), and more features.

### BREAKING CHANGES

* updated native ios sdk

* feat(ios): opt-in Swift Package Manager resolution for GoogleSignIn

Set $RNGoogleSigninDependencyManager = 'spm' in the Podfile to resolve
GoogleSignIn-iOS through React Native's spm_dependency instead of
CocoaPods. CocoaPods stays the default and its pod graph is unchanged.

This lets apps that already get Google's SDKs from SPM, such as React
Native Firebase 27 (Firebase 13 is SPM-only), link GTMSessionFetcher,
GoogleUtilities, AppCheckCore and Promises once instead of twice.

In SPM mode the Expo adapter no longer links GoogleSignIn: it is a static
framework, so it would merge a second copy of the SDK into the app. It
forwards sign-in URLs to RNGoogleSigninHandleURL in RNGoogleSignin.

* fix(ios): require iOS 15 when GoogleSignIn comes from SPM

GoogleSignIn 10, which SPM mode resolves, raised its minimum to iOS 15.
CocoaPods can't see an SPM package's minimum, so both pods now declare it
in SPM mode and pod install rejects older targets up front instead of the
build failing later. CocoaPods mode keeps iOS 10.0 and 13.4.

* feat(expo): iosDependencyManager config plugin option

Prebuild generates the Podfile, so Expo projects had no way to set
$RNGoogleSigninDependencyManager. The new iosDependencyManager option
('cocoapods' or 'spm') writes it into the generated Podfile. It works with
both the Firebase and the iosUrlScheme setup, and only ever touches its
own marked line, so repeated prebuilds don't duplicate it and switching
back to 'cocoapods' removes it.

* chore(ios): use GoogleSignIn 10.1.0 for both CocoaPods and SPM

One version field instead of GoogleSignInPodVersion plus GoogleSignInSPMVersion.
10.1.0 is the last GoogleSignIn CocoaPods release; SPM resolves it up to the next major.

* fix(expo): build the adapter from source in SPM mode

A prebuilt ExpoAdapterGoogleSignIn.xcframework may have been compiled for CocoaPods
mode, where it links GoogleSignIn directly instead of calling RNGoogleSigninHandleURL.

* fix(expo): remove the iosDependencyManager Podfile line when the option is omitted

The plugin now always reconciles its own marked line, treating an omitted option as
cocoapods, so a non-clean prebuild after dropping the option goes back to CocoaPods.
Handwritten assignments are left alone.

* chore(ios): require GoogleSignIn 10.1.0 in Package.swift

Matches GoogleSignInPodVersion, so SwiftPM apps also get the release that allows
